name: GOES-16 ABI infrared brightness temperatures and MRMS composite reflectivity dataset for convective initiation nowcasting
model_or_instrument: GOES-16 ABI, Multi-Radar Multi-Sensor (MRMS) radar network
resolution: 1.5-km uniform horizontal mesh (remapped from native ~2-km mesh), 32x32 pixels (48 km x 48 km square patches); lead times from 10 to 60 minutes

scales.note: GOES-16 ABI 7 IR channels remapped to 1.5 km (native ~2 km) with 5-min cadence; MRMS at 0.01 deg (~1.1 km) at 2-min cadence. Samples cover US Great Plains across June-July 2020 and June 2021 (~13-month span).
